name: larkspur-m3-agent-config

brief.objective: Deliver a support-agent configuration and measure its escalation behavior on held-out tickets.

notes: The intake's category becomes the required rule category food_illness_or_allergic_reaction. Must-escalate recall on the held-out split should be 1.0 over its three must-escalate tickets (two chargebacks and a bereavement), with precision of at least 0.3. The allergen question ticket is not must-escalate unless it reports a reaction.
